test_jax_verify: test the jax_verify python package by discovering and running *_test.py files from jax_verify/tests
build_jax_verify_package: build the jax_verify pip package using setuptools with find_namespace_packages and install_requires from requirements.txt
parse_requirements: parse requirements.txt and return a list of dependency strings for pip installation
create_test_suite: create a unittest test suite by discovering all *_test.py files in jax_verify/tests directory
setup_package_metadata: setup the jax_verify package metadata including name, version, description, author, and license information
